name: Repeating Sin
overview: Scripture teaches that merely professing faith or looking back on past ways is insufficient for entering the kingdom of heaven; true discipleship requires doing the Father's will and steadfast commitment without turning away. Believers are called to abide in Christ, the true vine, and not allow sin to reign or dominate their lives. Though we live under grace rather than the law, this grace is not a license to continue sinning, but rather the power to overcome it and live in obedience.
